description.value:
This slate chalice improbably holds one single drop of water in it at all times and helps refresh the wearer, sometimes at the expense of their enemies. The DC of all spells cast by Activating this item is 22.

  • Armor After you cast a spell by Activating the chalice, you are surrounded by a fine mist. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Concealed] until the beginning of your next turn.

  • Weapon (void) After you cast a spell by Activating the chalice, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional @Damage[2[void]] damage until the end of your next turn; the first time in a round you successfully deal this void damage, you gain 8 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute.
